# Add Reference/Flavor Items

## Post 13150 by Akalix (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2021-10-20T16:54:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=13150#p13150 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

One thing I always loved were small, flavor/reference items added in the game.

I've created a couple example suggestions here:

[Jar of Dirt](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) - A rare drop from Bloodsail Buccaneers.

[A Severed Horse's Head](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) - A rare drop from members of the Syndicate.

[Box of Espionage](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) - Rare chest item which, on use, hides the player in a crate. This crate will disappear on combat tag or player movement. It does not actually hide the player any.

[The Golden Ticket](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) - Rare world drop which begins a quest to visit Trias's Cheese, turned in to receive a comedically unreasonable amount of cheese (7 stacks or something). Horde equivalent would be added as well, but I don't have the time to think one up currently.
